strategies.label: USDC · DeFindex vault (idle on testnet)
strategies.notes: Lotus v1 on the PaltaLabs testnet USDC DeFindex vault. The Blend USDC strategy is registered in that vault but its allocation is 0 (invested_amount 0): deposit(invest=true) skips it, and only the vault's rebalance manager (a PaltaLabs key we do not control) could seed it. Deposits stay idle, no yield accrues; only scripts/07-simulate-yield (a donation to the contract) shows the surplus -> distribute loop.

strategies.label: USDC · DeFindex → Blend (live yield)
strategies.notes: Lotus v2 on our own DeFindex vault (Lotus USDC Blend, LUSDCB), seeded once with 1000 USDC into the Blend USDC strategy, so every deposit(invest=true) goes straight into Blend and vault_value() grows with the pool's b_rate every ledger. Measured on 2026-10-25: Blend supply rate about 6.9% APR (testnet pool at ~88.7% utilization, so it moves with other testnet users), vault fee 0. Proven on-chain: deposit, distribute of real surplus, partial and full redeem. See deployments/testnet.contract.v2.json (observed_apr) and deployments/README.md.
